description: This file defines the Aws\DocDBElastic\DocDBElasticClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with Amazon DocumentDB Elastic Clusters service, including operations like creating, deleting, listing clusters and snapshots, and managing tags.

classes.name: Aws\DocDBElastic\DocDBElasticClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon DocumentDB Elastic Clusters service, providing methods for cluster and snapshot management.

methods.name: applyPendingMaintenanceAction
methods.description: Initiates applying pending maintenance actions on a cluster.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new DocumentDB Elastic Cluster.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes an existing DocumentDB Elastic Cluster.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cluster.

methods.name: restoreClusterFromSnapshot
methods.description: Restores a cluster from a snapshot.

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates settings for an existing cluster.
